claim_boundary: The scalar Perron theorem, finite Dirichlet-polynomial inversion, finite Chebyshev specialization, and pointwise absolute convergence of the full von Mangoldt Perron series are kernel-checked. The growing-height integral/series interchange and explicit formula remain unproved.

missing_specialized_primitive.statement_shape: For nonintegral x > 1 and c > 1, the normalized finite-height vertical integral of (-zeta'/zeta)(s) x^s/s converges to Chebyshev.psi x.

next_smallest_proof_unit.completed_reduction: Fourier inversion closes the squared-Cauchy value and scalar Perron limit. Generic finite inversion and the finite von Mangoldt/Chebyshev specialization are proved. On Re(s)>1 the full Perron coefficient series is absolutely summable and its range partial sums converge pointwise to the von Mangoldt Perron kernel.
next_smallest_proof_unit.target: Prove domination or a two-parameter coefficient-tail estimate sufficient to pass from finite von Mangoldt Perron inversion to the full growing-height vertical integral.
next_smallest_proof_unit.reason: The finite and pointwise infinite statements are complete; only the noncompact integral/series limit exchange separates them from ChebyshevPerronInversionTarget.
